format: html

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("ggdendro", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggdendro", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org/")
}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggdendro)

# Source project themes and palettes
source(here("R", "theme_config.R"))
```

## Dataset Clustering by Resolved Foundational Inputs

We cluster the agricultural datasets using the fully resolved foundational inputs derived from the edge bundling analysis (unpacking map dependencies into their origin remote sensing or statistical bases). We filter out "National Statistics" to maintain consistency with our primary analysis.

```{r resolved-clustering}
# Load lineage links computed in 01_data_prep.qmd
links <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "network_links.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter out National Statistics and convert to wide binary matrix
dataset_resolved_wide <- links |>
  filter(!(input_type == "In Situ & Survey Data" & source == "National Statistics")) |>
  distinct(dataset, source) |>
  mutate(present = 1) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = source,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = list(present = 0)
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("dataset")

# Compute Jaccard distance matrix
dist_mat_resolved <- dist(dataset_resolved_wide, method = "binary")

# Perform hierarchical clustering using Ward's method
hc_resolved <- hclust(dist_mat_resolved, method = "ward.D2")
```

## Dendrogram Visualization

```{r plot-resolved-dendrogram, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
# Extract dendrogram data
dendro_data_hc_resolved <- dendro_data(hc_resolved, type = "rectangle")

segment_data_resolved <- segment(dendro_data_hc_resolved)
label_data_resolved   <- label(dendro_data_hc_resolved)

# Join category information to dataset labels
ds_categories <- links |>
  distinct(dataset, dataset_group) |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()

label_data_resolved <- label_data_resolved |>
  left_join(ds_categories, by = c("label" = "dataset"))

# Create dendrogram plot
p_dendro_resolved <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = segment_data_resolved,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    color = project_palette[["node_parent"]], linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_data_resolved,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = dataset_group),
    hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", nudge_y = 0.01,
    key_glyph = "point"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 2.2))) +
  scale_color_category() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_dendro_resolved
```

## Save Outputs

```{r save-outputs}
dir.create(here("outputs", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  here("outputs", "figures", "dataset_ancestry_resolved_dendrogram.png"),
  p_dendro_resolved, width = 10, height = 12
)

ggsave(
  here("outputs", "figures", "dataset_ancestry_resolved_dendrogram.pdf"),
  p_dendro_resolved, width = 10, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf
)
```
